snippet.title: CTHULOOP - Longplay (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
A no-commentary longplay/walkthrough for the video game CTHULOOP. This is a game I developed myself, and is an expanded version of my submission to the GMTK 2025 Game Jam. The theme of the jam was: Loop.

Credits to all art and sound assets used are contained in the video and in the game.

Link to game: https://ryan-butts.itch.io/cthuloop
Link to my itch.io developer page: https://ryan-butts.itch.io/
